/* Evidence Lab game layer: no external dependencies or persistence */
.hud{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.rank{display:inline-block;background:#ffd16f;color:#183746;font-weight:850;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:99px}
.topnav button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;align-items:flex-start;min-width:130px}
.topnav button small{font-size:11px;opacity:.85}.topnav button.case-done:not(.active){background:#225e57;border-color:#98dcc0}
.stage-head,.question-top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap}
.case-label,.micro{font-weight:850;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.11em;color:#437281}
.mission-strip{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#ecf8fc;border:1px solid #c4e5ee;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:12px;margin-top:16px}
.mission-strip p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}.case-meter{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:12px;min-width:75px;padding:10px;background:white;border:1px solid #cae4e9}.case-meter strong{font-size:23px}.case-meter span{font-size:11px}
.resolved-pill,.pending-pill,.review-pill{display:inline-block;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.045em;font-size:10px;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#e8f0f4;color:#335b6c}.resolved-pill{background:#e1f5e9;color:#1b6e43}.review-pill{background:#fff0d8;color:#8b5115}
.badge-unlocked{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:#133b4a;color:white;margin-top:18px;border-radius:13px;padding:19px;box-shadow:0 9px 20px #132c3820}.badge-unlocked p{margin:4px 0 0;line-height:1.5}.badge-medal{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;border-radius:50%;width:68px;height:68px;background:#f5c765;color:#163746;font-size:37px;border:5px solid #e7ac3a;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #f7dd96}
.final-stars{color:#ffd16f;letter-spacing:12px;font-size:26px}.end{margin-top:20px;text-align:center;padding:30px}.end button{background:#ffd16f;border:0;font-weight:bold}
.secondary{background:#f3f8fa}.nav-actions{justify-content:space-between}.figure img.zoomed{max-height:none}
@media(max-width:600px){.topnav button{min-width:105px}.mission-strip{padding:11px}.badge-medal{width:54px;height:54px;font-size:28px}.final-stars{letter-spacing:5px}}

Twenty evidence clues. Unlock badges, earn first-try stars, and become a Master Investigator. All the fun, none of the grades.</p><div class="progress" aria-label="Practice progress"><div id="bar" style="width:0%"></div></div><div class="hud"><div class="stat" id="stats"></div><div class="rank" aria-live="polite">RANK: <span id="rank">New Recruit</span></div></div><nav class="topnav" id="tabs" aria-label="Study cases"></nav></div></header><main><div class="callout"><strong>Before you answer:</strong> Identify the claim, find the relevant evidence, then consider what the evidence can actually prove. A cautious answer is not automatically the best answer. <strong>Game rules:</strong> Correct answers close clues; after a wrong answer, retry or reveal the explanation. Five completed cases unlock the final rank. Progress stays only on this open page and resets on reload—nothing is submitted.</div><div id="workspace"></div><p class="foot">Historical references: Maddison Project Database 2023; NCES; CDC/NCHS; Joseph Keppler (1889); Pullman cartoon (1894); Joseph Nimmo (1894); Jacob Riis (1890); Lewis Hine / NCLC (1909); People’s Party Omaha Platform (1892); Kopczuk & Saez (2004).
